system: Van der Pol, four supplied free coefficients
pairing: consecutive independent records; pair differences remove the shared unknown deterministic mean
covariance_estimation: mean pair-difference squared values for two marginal variances; pooled lag product divided by pooled truncated squared values for rho; tau=-h/log(rho)
gmm: initial ordinary least squares on mean Hermite-corrected moments, one optimal update using empirical pair influence covariance including estimated-variance correction
weight_relaxation: add diag(empirical influence covariance)/number_of_pairs; tends to zero
intervals: marginal normal 1.959963984540054 and joint chi-square(4) 95 percent; pair-cluster sandwich with nuisance influence
quadrature: fixed-grid deterministic weak defect and pseudo-target disclosed; theoretical consistency requires exact integrals or vanishing grid error
sampling: within each repetition all record counts are prefixes of 800 independent records; independent repetitions, no adaptive stopping
numerical_failures: retain and report all planned repetitions; no outcome-based exclusions
